constraints: priority must be one of the named 'Cache Management' theme constants (Cache priority low / Cache priority very low / Cache priority normal / Cache priority high / Cache priority very high), not an arbitrary Integer.
Only works in local mode (4D Server or 4D single-user); cannot be used in 4D remote mode.
Applies to all indexes on aField, including keyword indexes, but does not change composite-index priority.
A new call replaces any priority previously set by this command in the same process.
